in_hebrew.name: Beller
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Fair one, beautiful
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Beller הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word βελλερος (belleros), meaning 'fair one' or 'beautiful'. In Greek mythology, Bellerophon was a hero who rode the winged horse Pegasus and slayed the Chimera monster.

in_greek.name: Beller
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Fair one, beautiful
in_greek.long_meaning: Beller είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word βελλερος (belleros), meaning 'fair one' or 'beautiful'. In Greek mythology, Bellerophon was a hero who rode the winged horse Pegasus and slayed the Chimera monster.

in_latin.name: Beller
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Fair one, beautiful
in_latin.long_meaning: Beller est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word βελλερος (belleros), meaning 'fair one' or 'beautiful'. In Greek mythology, Bellerophon was a hero who rode the winged horse Pegasus and slayed the Chimera monster.
